summary: Pappas reaffirmed Israel's right to exist, voted for Iron Dome and military aid, called for Hamas destruction, and stated he has 'never wavered' in support of Israel. He voted Yea on H.R. 6090 and sponsored H.R. 1007, both embedding the IHRA definition in education enforcement. Vote for Peace rated him Opposed and Track AIPAC spent against him. His humanitarian airdrop calls and 2026 vote against the anti-BDS Act are noted, but his framing stays anchored in Israel security.
